description: MODIFIES THE CHECKLY ACCOUNT: schedules a maintenance window that silences alerts for a time range (e.g. during a deploy). Omit repeatUnit for a one-off window. Public API: POST /v1/maintenance-windows.

repeatUnit.description: For a recurring window: DAY, WEEK, or MONTH. Omit for one-off.

silenceAllAlerts.description: Silence alerts for ALL checks (overrides tag scoping).

tags.description: Tags of checks/groups to include in the window.

name: checkly_create_maintenance_window
title: Create maintenance window
